title: 법무부감찰위원회 규정 / queue:ADDENDUM:19513:20060612:00002:part:1/1
full_text:
ADDENDA (Regulations on Personnel Administration of the Senior Executive Service) <No. 19513, June 12, 2006>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date) This Decree shall enter into force on July 1, 2006.

Articles 2 and 3 Omitted.

Article 4 (Amendment of Other Statutes and Regulations) (1) through (97) Omitted.

(98) The Regulations on the Ministry of Justice Inspection and Audit Committee are partially amended as follows:

In Article 2 (2) 1, "public officials of Grade III or higher belonging to the Ministry of Justice or prosecutors' offices" shall be replaced with "public officials of Grade III belonging to the Ministry of Justice or prosecutors' offices, and general-service public officials belonging to the Senior Executive Service".

(99) through (241) Omitted.
